##About
The Kona Dew Boston is our mainstay rental bike – made custom just for us, these bikes are high quality, lightweight, and comfortable for all-day riding in the city. With a wide range of gears, you can get up and down Beacon Hill with ease, and lightweight, durable components ensure that the bike doesn’t weigh you down. Our bright green, reflective fenders are our trademark around Boston’s neighborhoods, and we bet that you’ll see many more of them as you cruise through all of Boston’s breathtaking sights!

Whether you’re taking a self-guided tour or participating in one of New England’s many charity rides, our city bikes are great for all-around riding. If you need some ideas on where to go, simply check out our routes page!
 

##More Information
2-hour rentals as well as weekly rentals are priced on the following page.

All rentals include helmets, locks, flat kits and lights upon request.

Have some little ones with you? We also offer kid’s bikes & accessories for rent.

Delivery is subject to availability, on a case by case basis. We request at least 48-hour notice for deliveries. Please call us to discuss availability prior to booking.
